gameplayAdaptations: Explicitly labeled as a fictional literary interpretation of Tao Yuanming's 421 CE prose 'Peach Blossom Spring' (Taohua Yuan Ji).

Underlying terrain uses the verified real-world DEM of the Wuling / Taoyuan stream valley in Changde, Hunan (where the historical Wuling commandery of the text was situated), adapted with a walkable stream pass and enclosed terraced orchard.
